name: Gantam Papam Gatam Dukham
meaning: When I see you, my sins, sorrows and poverty vanish, and joy, prosperity and virtue arrive.
purpose: A verse of darshan, seeing the divine.
note: The wording in the client list could not be matched to a published verse; the text is held back until it is checked.
supplied:
Gantam Papam Gatam Dukham,
Gatam Daridramevacha,
Agatha Sukha Sampatthi,
Punyam Cha Tva Darshanam.
